data.name: S_Display_StartupDisplay_D
data.value: Automatically open the floating window after the program starts

data.name: S_Display_Opacity_D
data.value: Applies to both the main floating window and the quick-draw window

data.name: S_Display_TopmostMode_D
data.value: Choose whether the floating window stays above other windows

data.name: S_Display_TopmostMode_Windows_D
data.value: Choose how the floating window stays on top (UIAccess requests administrator permission on restart; cancellation or failure uses ordinary topmost for this launch)

data.name: S_Buttons_RollCall_D
data.value: Show the roll-call entry in the floating window

data.name: S_Buttons_QuickDraw_D
data.value: Show the quick-draw entry in the floating window

data.name: S_Buttons_Lottery_D
data.value: Show the lottery entry in the floating window

data.name: S_Interaction_StickToEdge_D
data.value: Snap to the nearest left or right edge of the current screen when dragging ends

data.name: S_Interaction_Draggable_D
data.value: When disabled, neither the main floating window nor its handle can be dragged

data.name: S_Interaction_DoNotStealFocus_D
data.value: Try not to take focus from the current window when the floating window is clicked

data.name: S_Interaction_HideOnForegroundProcessNames_D
data.value: Separate names with semicolons ; and hide the floating window when a process matches, such as WeChat.exe

data.name: S_Interaction_HideOnForeground_D
data.value: Automatically hide the floating window when the foreground window title or process matches

data.name: S_Interaction_LongPressDuration_D
data.value: Milliseconds required to trigger a long-press action

data.name: S_Interaction_StickToEdgeRecoverSeconds_D
data.value: Wait this many seconds after docking before collapsing; set to 0 to keep expanded

data.name: S_Interaction_HideOnForegroundWindowTitles_D
data.value: Separate with semicolons ; and hide when the title contains matching text

data.name: S_Buttons_EnabledItems_D
data.value: Choose the feature entries shown in the main floating window

data.name: S_Buttons_Placement_D
data.value: Rectangle uses a two-column grid; vertical and horizontal use a single column

data.name: S_Buttons_DisplayStyle_D
data.value: Choose icons, text, or both for floating-window controls

data.name: S_Buttons_Size_D
data.value: Adjust the side length of each square control; the icon and text scale with it

data.name: S_Interaction_StickToEdgeDisplayStyle_D
data.value: Choose a roll-call icon, the word “Draw,” or a direction arrow for the edge handle

data.name: S_Dock_Size_D
data.value: Adjust the square side length of the edge handle
